idle_sub: Noam will open a session for you in a moment.
lang_sub: בחר שפה · Выберите язык · Choisissez votre langue · קלייבט אַ שפּראַך
privacy_note: Only you can see your data.
with_you: Noam Heller will be with you
connect_sub: Three steps. No rush — Noam is right here.
step1_b: The cable is on the desk. Connect it to your phone.
step2_b: Enter your code on the phone to unlock it.
step3_b: A notice will appear on your phone — tap it. If not, Noam will help.
src_sub: Choose the device to copy from.
browse_sub: Only you can see this content.
consent_sub: Please read. If everything is clear, sign below.
c1: {n} files ({size}) will be copied from your device to the disk.
c2: Nothing on your device will be deleted or changed.
c3: Every file is checked after copying against the original, to make sure it is identical.
c4: Noam sees numbers and status only — never the content.
c5: When done you will get a signed report with the results.
sign_here: Sign with your finger inside the box
progress_sub: Feel free to sit down. Do not disconnect the device.
done_sub: {n} files · {size} · every file checked against the original.
done_skips: {s} files could not be read from the device. They are listed in the report.
nothing_deleted: Nothing was deleted from your device.
report_b: Noam will print a signed report for you. A copy is also on your disk.
stopped_sub: Nothing was deleted from your device. Noam will explain the next step.
reason_other: Something went wrong at the station.
r_ERR_ADB_UNAUTHORIZED: Needs approval on the phone screen
r_ERR_NO_STORAGE_VISIBLE: Phone locked or "File transfer" not chosen
err_generic: Something did not work. Noam will help.
